checkpoints.summary: New physical Win7 evidence refines the crash boundary: Settings and Cantiere can be entered and remain usable; the application crashes when entering Assistente. All diagnostic probes whose labels begin with 0 produce no visible failure, while probes 1 and 2 crash. This points to Assistente/model-load or update initialization rather than generic navigation, Flutter interaction, or whole-app shell.
decisions: Treat Settings and Cantiere navigation as physically safe in this candidate.
Focus the bounded claim on Assistente initialization and the model/update chain it starts.
Do not merge from CI alone and do not change Win8.1/10/11 behavior.
evidence_refs: physical:0-series probes no visible failure; probes 1 and 2 crash
checkpoints.next_action: Inspect PR #736 Assistente entry path and split the first Assistente/model-load initialization stages into one narrower Win7 diagnostic candidate.

checkpoints.summary: Physical Win7 evidence further refines the boundary: the Settings shell itself opens, but runtime-backed Settings submenus are not generally safe. The Models submenu crashes, and attempting to download voices also crashes. Cantiere shell/navigation remains usable, while entering Assistente crashes.
decisions: Do not classify Settings as globally safe; only its top-level shell/navigation is known safe.
The common failure class is now runtime/service-backed feature initialization or plugin/native work, not Assistente-specific navigation.
Correlate Assistente entry, Models submenu, voice download, and probes 1/2 to identify their first shared native/plugin/runtime dependency before creating the next candidate.
Keep Win8.1/10/11 behavior unchanged and do not merge from CI alone.
evidence_refs: physical:Win7 build #1175 Settings Models submenu crashes
physical:Win7 build #1175 voice download action crashes
physical:0-series probes no visible failure; probes 1 and 2 crash
checkpoints.next_action: Inspect the code paths for Assistente entry, Settings Models, voice download, and probes 1/2; identify the earliest shared runtime/plugin/native dependency and build one narrower Win7-only diagnostic candidate.

checkpoints.summary: Additional physical Win7 evidence: entering/configuring Diagnostics far enough to add the token is possible, but attempting to send logs crashes the application. Combined with Assistente entry, Models submenu, voice download, and probes 1/2 crashes, failures span multiple unrelated feature domains and occur when service/network/runtime-backed operations start.
decisions: Add Diagnostics log upload to the shared-crash correlation set.
Do not assume the root cause is model-specific, voice-specific, or Assistente-specific.
Prioritize the earliest common service/network/plugin/native layer invoked by model/update, voice download, Diagnostics upload, and Assistente initialization.
Preserve separate Win7 evidence gate and do not merge from CI alone.

physical:Win7 build #1175 sending Diagnostics logs crashes
checkpoints.next_action: Correlate Diagnostics upload with Models/update, voice download and Assistente code paths; isolate their earliest shared network/plugin/native dependency before changing production behavior.

checkpoints.summary: Created bounded Win7 child diagnostic PR #761 from #736. It adds only probe 0E: built-in model path resolution followed by GGUF header validation via the existing _validateModelFileDetailed path. This isolates File.length/open/readInto/close before SharedPreferences or any network work. No production autostart or modern-Windows behavior changed.
decisions: Use 0E as the next single physical discriminator.
If 0E crashes, split RandomAccessFile validation primitives before investigating network.
If 0E stays open, the full model crash lies after built-in validation; then isolate stored-model refresh/selection separately while keeping the broader network crash evidence in scope.
Do not merge PR #761 from CI alone.
